subject: writing
title: A Storm Arrives
text:
The deadly Storm 

My hands were trembling. The Strong wind howled and roared as it continued. My heart pounded. I was just at the park when a bizzare siren whooped through the town. I was clueless about what was happening. While I was walking back, a nearby neighbour asked me if i was crazy. I had no idea what she was talking about, I eagerly asked what was happening. My mind went blank when she said tornado. 


I rushed home in the  gust of wind. My younger sister was at home all alone and our parents had gone to the festive shop to buy decoratives for our house. I reached home and shouted for my sister, atlast she was there, I breathed a sigh of relief. I quickly turned on the TV to check the news. It had said WARNING : TORNADO. I had closed all the windows and locked all the doors immedietly. My body was shivering. 


Realising my sister said something while i was watching i realised she was outside checking what was happening. I quickly snatched her inside to avoid the danger outside. I had forgot about our parents they were thuding on the door i thought it was the wind. I rushed to the doorand gently opened it. The were drenched with dirt and water. I was so relieved. The roar started to calm down while we were all sleeping to forget the rain and thunder.


We had gone through a tornado by sleeping. Mum opened the door the wind was cold. We all looked outside it was lighltly raining. The whole road was destroyed in the hard rain. The cars were flipped, papers flying everywhere, chairs everything was gone except our house and us we all were safe atlast.
